reviewed_finding: Read primitive_axiomatics.rs (sha256 c1ae6edb matches the pin): the enum PrimitiveDifferenceAxiom (line 24) has ten names and no predicate; the kernel (line 38) enforces A1 and carrier membership and stores the token; EvaluationPreorder (line 69), the cochain tests (lines 285-350) and TriadSignature::r_cl (line 159) realise A3, A5 and the triad rule on fixed instances. The other bound source, DerivationDagQMClosure.lean::pg_six_operations_and_primdiff_admission_gate (line 764, sha256 c9ad9c23), contains `(x != y and 0 < 2) iff x.val != y.val` on Fin 4, a tautology that is not about the kernel or the axioms; it is vacuous for this node. The paper pin tfq_0394 records the list as underived and says the enum and test_primitive_difference.py were not opened. An external copy of the Rust file (different bytes, sha256 e39ae75e) carries one-line doc glosses for A1-A10; they were used only as readings for A4, A6, A7, A9 and are not pinned. Result: a transcription of the checkable parts into decidable predicates with explicit statuses, general Lean theorems for the kernel and the cochain facts, and exhaustive native tables on carriers of up to three points.

claim_boundary.supports: The pinned Rust source lists ten axiom NAMES with no predicate attached; the only enforcement is GenesisAdmissionKernel::admit_difference, which checks a != b (A1) and then carrier membership. Kernel-checked for arbitrary name types: the transcribed kernel accepts a pair iff a != b and both are in the carrier, checks A1 first, never inspects the token (acceptance is token-independent) and keeps its admitted pairs irreflexive and inside the carrier (INSTANCES: duplicates and both orientations are accepted); the reflexive-transitive closure is the least preorder containing a relation (A3); the face boundary of a coboundary vanishes for every potential iff the three boundary edges are all present or all absent (and the decidable form A5 of the instance section is equivalent to that nilpotence); a coboundary descends to the quotient by im d0 iff d1 o d0 = 0, so A7 read as "d1 vanishes on im d0" (our reading of an unpinned gloss) is A5 again; any Nat-valued defect of the form inf over phi of N(h - d0 phi) is gauge invariant (A6; the rational-valued Phi1 of the source is not covered, and its gauge invariance is tested natively only for shifts in {-1,0,1}^n); for the TRANSCRIBED rule rcl (none exactly when Phi = 0 and Gamma != 0, Gamma read as the coboundary) the exact-but-not-closed cell is empty iff d1 o d0 = 0 and nonempty otherwise. The source cannot reach its own None branch through compute_triad_signature: its complex constructor rejects d1 o d0 != 0 (gamma2.rs verify_chain_law), it refuses a face with a missing edge (test_triad_refuses_malformed_input) and its Gamma2 is evaluated on the Phi1 residual. Native tables, in the PRODUCT model (D, E, F, alpha) on carriers of 1, 2, 3 points with at most one face (0,1,2), present only for n = 3: A1 reads the admitted relation D, A3/A4/A5/A7 read the evaluation relation E and the face flag F, and A10 is read from a free flag alpha with no further content, so independence of A1 and A10 from the other axioms is true by construction and the one computed interaction is A4 versus A5. Order of violate_only is [A1, A3, A4, A5, A7, A10]: all-axiom models 1, 12, 2304; A1, A4 and A10 are each violable alone from one point (counts 1, 1, 1 at n=1; 36, 52, 12 at n=2; 16128, 38656, 2304 at n=3); A3 is never violated; A5 and A7 fail together (entries 4 and 5 of violate_only are structurally 0), jointly only from n=3 (1152 structures) because the encoding has a face only for n=3. A5 without well-formedness (a floating face with no boundary edge present) holds in 65536 structures at n=3. In the product model the empty structure is always a model and each off-diagonal pair lies in exactly half the models; since A2 is not a state predicate this shows only that the encoding forces no admission. The kernel facts are a transcription of admit_difference checked against a reading of the pinned source (the checker re-simulates it; no gate executes the real GenesisAdmissionKernel). Also native: closure counts 1, 4, 29 preorders and six named complexes with exact/closed/rupture counts, the transcribed rule rcl evaluated on (Phi1, coboundary L1 norm) per cochain, and gauge invariance of the unit-weight L1 distance.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: A derivation of the axiom list (obligation GEN-WDP-O01 and paper pin tfq_0394 stay open: this is a transcription and a small-model study, not a justification); that the predicates for A2, A4 and A6-A9 are the intended ones (the pinned file has names only; the one-line glosses come from an external copy of the file whose bytes differ from the pin); independence of A1 and A10 as a finding about the axioms (it holds by construction of the product model); A9: the relabelling check is an isomorphism (permuting vertex labels while keeping the cochain index-wise) and cannot fail, so it says nothing about observer-selected metrics; carriers of more than 3 points; real-valued Phi1, Gamma2 and R_cl values (here Phi1 is the unit-weight L1 distance to im d0 in integers and Gamma the L1 norm of d1 h); that the exact/closed classification equals classify_exact; any reachability of the source r_cl None branch; the Born, Hilbert or physical reading of any axiom.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: In a small product model (carriers of at most three points, at most one triangular face, A10 a free flag), the transcribed axioms A1, A4, A5 and A10 are jointly satisfiable and A1, A4, A10 are each violable alone from one point and A5 (together with A7) from three points; A3 holds because a reflexive-transitive closure is a preorder; A7 is A5 under the reading of A7 as d1 vanishing on im d0; the kernel enforces only A1 and carrier membership (the token is stored, never checked); and the transcribed R_cl rule refuses exactly on the exact-but-not-closed cell that d1 o d0 = 0 empties, a branch the source cannot reach because it rejects d1 o d0 != 0 at construction. This is evidence about a transcription of the list, not a derivation of it.
claim_boundary.next_test: Obtain the definitions of A2, A4 and A6-A9 from the FOC-006 / FOC-000 sources (not bound here), replace the gloss-based predicates by them, and decide whether A9 is independent at all: test it with a weighted L1 norm whose weights are not permuted with the vertices (an observer-selected metric), since the present relabelling check is an isomorphism and cannot fail.

second_review.notes: Cold read of the final run (profile, candidate, the 388-line check_candidate.py, semantic_mutants.py, public cases, p2 lean.stdout.log, p4 host_check), lean4/PrimdiffAxioms.lean (sha256 f4197451 identical to p1/construction), the pinned primitive_axiomatics.rs (enum lines 24-35 and admit_difference lines 53-65) and the DAG node, before the earlier pass. Statement fidelity: Kernel.admit is a faithful transcription of admit_difference (a = b gives A1, then carrier, then push with token); admit_error_a1 states that A1 is checked first for every kernel (even outside the carrier); admit_ok_iff, admit_token_irrelevant, admit_preserves_inv, duplicates_stored and reverse_orientation_accepted say what supports says (the last two are instances). face_nilpotent_iff is stated for distinct vertices and the partial coboundary d1E and gives 'all three boundary edges present or all absent'; descends_iff and exact_closed/exact_not_closed/trichotomy are abstract AddMonoidHom statements; defect_gauge_invariant is Nat-valued (scope correctly limited); rcl_eq_none_iff is the rule itself; rcl_defined_of_nilpotent takes the biconditional hypotheses on Phi and Gamma as hypotheses (supports says 'hypotheses about the functionals'). All lean.stdout.log axiom reports are the Mathlib-classical triple or propext; no choice-freeness is claimed for this node, so nothing to object to. I recomputed by hand: all-hold models 1, 12, 2304 (= 2^(n^2-n) times 3^C(n,2) for n < 3, times 27 + 9 at n = 3); the violate_only vector at n = 3 for A1 (16128), the 1152 joint A5/A7 failures (64 irreflexive D times 18 asymmetric E with one or two forward face edges, A10 true), the 65536 floating-face structures (64 E times 512 D times 2), the preorder counts 1, 4, 29, and the broken-face refusals (6 of 9: closed means h01 + h12 = 0, 3 of 9). All agree with the certificate. Earlier-pass amendments: (a) applied: violate_only has its documented order [A1, A3, A4, A5, A7, A10] and the 'A1, A4, A10 each violable alone from one point' wording is correct against the certificate (1,1,1 at n=1); the product-model sentence (A10 a free flag, independence of A1 and A10 by construction) is in supports and narrowest_claim; the R_cl clause is qualified (transcribed rule only; the source constructor rejects d1 o d0 != 0) and half_attached_face now says the transcribed rule would refuse and the source refuses to build the complex; the A6 clause is limited to Nat-valued defects; the kernel clause admits that no gate runs the real GenesisAdmissionKernel; the next_test is about whether A9 is independent at all; composition_tree is only coboundary_d1(coboundary_d0(phi)); the Lean lemma a5_iff_nilpotent links the decidable A5 to d1E-nilpotence; the missing mutants exist (floating_face_is_well_formed, a3_violable, a1_needs_two_points, diagonal_admission, filled_triangle_refuses; 17 semantic mutants, 576 coordinate, all rejected). (b) Rebuild vs checker: the checker no longer hard-codes the kernel booleans; _Kernel.admit simulates the guards for every (a, b, token) probe and the booleans (token_irrelevant, duplicates_stored, reverse_orientation_admitted, a1_before_carrier) are computed. rcl_refusals is now computed per cochain by forming (Phi1, Gamma) and applying the rule (ratio is None), instead of aliasing exact_nonclosed. A3 is computed by boolean matrix power; the all-hold count is cross-checked against the closed-form product. The checker's local Phi1 uses an integer box of +-7 with phi[0] fixed (WLOG by gauge); adequate for these complexes. (c) Not caught by the earlier pass, all text-level: (i) the sealed profile still says in independent_predicates that 'kernel counts [are computed] by closed forms 2n(n-1), 2(n+1), probes minus both' and the checker docstring says the same, but the code simulates the kernel by enumeration; the closed forms are not used. The statement about the method is stale, the evidence is fine. (ii) challenge_plan says 'twelve semantic near misses' but there are seventeen, listing the older twelve. (iii) supports says 'the decidable form A5 of the instance section is equivalent to that nilpotence', which is backed by PrimdiffAxioms.a5_iff_nilpotent; that theorem is NOT in the profile anchors or p2_checks.lean.anchors (21 axiom reports are printed, 20 anchors are named), so the host's 'required named Lean reports' gate did not require it, although it is compiled and its axiom report (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) is in lean.stdout.log. (iv) The identification 'A7 is A5' has two layers: in Lean descends_iff is abstract (d1.comp d0 = 0) and is not instantiated at d1E; in the native tables a5_equals_a7 holds because both are tested by the same linear d1 on unit or {-1,0,1} potentials. It remains a consequence of the chosen reading of an unpinned gloss, which the claim now says. (v) The R_cl cell statements are joined to the concrete Phi1 and Gamma2 only by hypotheses (hPhi, hGamma) in Lean and by the native unit-weight integer L1 tables; the 'refuses exactly on the exact-but-not-closed cell' sentence is therefore a statement about the transcribed rule on these tables plus abstract lemmas, not about the source. The claim already says this. (vi) does_not_support does not list the absence of a gate that executes the real GenesisAdmissionKernel/TriadSignature (it is only said inside supports); it should be a does_not_support item. next_test (get A2, A4, A6-A9 definitions from FOC sources and test A9 with a non-permuted weighted norm) is this node's own obligation and is not a restatement of does_not_support.

earlier_pass.notes: Cold read of specsB/PG-PRIMDIFF-AXIOMS.json, primdiff_axioms_{check,format,semantic,spec}.py, lean4/PrimdiffAxioms.lean (compiled, exit 0), pfp_primdiff_axioms.py, its test, the Rust module, code/rust/src/wdp/primitive_axiomatics.rs (sha256 prefix c1ae6edb, line numbers 24/38/53/69/135/159/176 and tests 258-338 verified), code/rust/src/functional/gamma2.rs, wdp/cochains.rs, the operad yaml and the DAG node (status DEFINITION). The kernel facts (A1 first, then carrier, token pushed and never read, duplicates and reverse orientation accepted) match admit_difference exactly. The Lean statements say what they are cited for, with these exceptions: A5 and A4 in the Lean instance section are defined by the equivalent face form and are not proved equal to the d1E definition in Lean (the link is prose); defect_gauge_invariant is for N : B -> Nat, whereas the source Phi1 is rational-valued; a1_a4_a5_independent_on_three_vertices does not mention A10. The most serious issues are about what the native tables mean. (1) The model space is the product (D, E, F, alpha) with A1 reading D only, A3/A4/A5/A7 reading (E,F) only, and A10 read from a free flag alpha that has no content (the producer's a_hist is {True:1, False:1}); so independence of A1 and A10 from the rest, 'no admission is forced' (each off-diagonal pair in exactly half the models) and the model counts 8/512/1048576 factorisation are true by construction of the encoding, not findings about the axioms; the only computed coupling is A4 with A5. A5 is violable 'only from three points' only because faces_of returns no face for n != 3 and the single face is (0,1,2). (2) The sentence 'A1, A4, A10 each violable alone from n=1, 2, 2' contradicts the certificate: violate_only (order A1, A3, A4, A5, A7, A10) is [1,0,1,0,0,1] at n=1, [36,0,52,0,0,12] at n=2, [16128,0,38656,0,0,2304] at n=3, so all three are violable alone from n=1; the order of the six entries is documented nowhere, and entries 4 and 5 are structurally 0 because A5 and A7 fail together (the 1152 at n=3 is violate_a5_a7_jointly). (3) The R_cl claim does not describe the source. In the source, ExactCochainComplexQ::try_new calls verify_chain_law and rejects d1 o d0 != 0 (gamma2.rs, test_exact_gamma2_rejects_nonzero_d1_d0); a face with a missing edge is refused by compute_triad_signature (primitive_axiomatics.rs test_triad_refuses_malformed_input, WdpError::Homology); and Gamma2 is evaluated on the Phi1 primal residual h - d0 phi*, which is zero whenever Phi1 = 0. So the None branch of TriadSignature::r_cl is unreachable through compute_triad_signature, and the 'exact-not-closed' cell (with Gamma read as d1 h) cannot arise from the source. The transcribed rule rcl and the cell statements are true, but 'which is exactly where the source r_cl rule refuses', the counterexample 'half_attached_face ... r_cl refuses on them' and the narrowest-claim clause about R_cl need this qualification; the operad's own failed_composition (source constructor rejects such a face) contradicts its counterexample. Also rcl_refusals is just exact_nonclosed copied in both producer and checker; no (Phi, Gamma) values are formed and rcl applied. (4) A7 = A5 is true only because A7 is read as 'd1 vanishes on im d0' from an unpinned external gloss; both producer and checker test it on unit/small potentials, which is linear restatement of A5. (5) The kernel booleans are constants in the checker (token_irrelevant etc. all True; diagonal_pairs_in_a_model = 0; A3 position fixed True in joint), the probe counts are closed forms, and no p2 gate runs the real GenesisAdmissionKernel (the finite_probability crate does not depend on the wdp crate), so the kernel table is a transcription checked against itself and against a human reading; the Lean Kernel.admit is the third transcription. (6) A9 'relabel_invariant' permutes the vertex labels in the edge list while keeping the cochain index-wise, which produces an isomorphic instance, so it cannot fail for any norm; the next_test speaks of A9 'staying' independent although A9 independence was never tested (status checked_on_named_complexes). I recomputed by hand: all_hold 1/12/2304 (=2^(n^2-n) * (3^(n(n-1)/2) or 27+9)), A5 count 655360 at n=3, the 1152, the nine-cochain double_edge tally (exact 3, closed-nonexact 6, phi1_sum 8), the filled triangle (7 exact, 20 rupture) and preorder counts 1, 4, 29. Those are correct. Mutants are consistent single-misreading edits, but there is none for the floating face (A5 without well-formedness) or for A3.
